name: BOOT hands you the next agent: who needs you, then the newest idle
case: Three agent sessions: one finished a while ago and sits idle, one asks the person for permission, and one finished just now. The person presses Boop's button: it opens the one that needs them. Pressing again straight away opens the one that just finished, and again the one that finished a while ago. Ten seconds later, a press starts at the top again: the one that needs them.
why: Core.pressed and Core.line: those that need you, oldest first, then the idle ones, the one that finished last first; presses within Core.walkMs (8 s) walk down the line, and after it a press starts again. A press is the board's own reaction (its handoff), so it wakes no brain
